MLBB hero builds 2026: what players build in ranked

Items, emblems and battle spells for all 133 ranked heroes, with search by name and a lane filter.

Hero builds

In this story

  1. Hero builds
  2. Most common items
  3. Emblems
  4. Battle spells
All news
In this story
Hero buildsMost common itemsEmblemsBattle spells

In brief

  • The most common core item is War Axe: it is in the most picked build of 26 heroes out of 133.
  • The most picked emblem is the Assassin emblem, used by 37 heroes. The Common emblem is chosen for only 5.
  • Flicker is the main spell for 60 heroes out of 133, Retribution for 20.

Each hero is shown with the most picked ranked build, the same one as in the hero profile. The three items form the core of the build, and the win rate counts matches played with that setup. Tap a hero’s row to see item names, talents and the battle spell.

Most common items

The most common core items
ItemHeroes with it in the build
War Axe26 of 133

There is no single item everyone must buy: even the most common one, War Axe, is in the build of only every fifth hero. The rest are shared by heroes of the same role.

Emblems

Which emblems players pick
EmblemHeroes
Assassin37
Mage27

Emblems are chosen by the hero’s job, not only by role. That is why the Assassin emblem shows up on mages and the Fighter emblem on some marksmen: the Academy shows these heroes win more often with them.

Battle spells

Which battle spells players take
Battle spellHeroes
Flicker60
Retribution20
Petrify12
Revitalize11
Vengeance11
Inspire6

Flicker stays the all-round choice for almost half the heroes: it saves you from death and helps start a fight. Junglers take Retribution, without which you cannot clear jungle monsters quickly.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I see the build for a specific MLBB hero?

On the hero page in our tier list: the most popular ranked build, the emblem with three talents, the battle spell and two alternatives. The data refreshes every few days.

Which emblem is picked most in MLBB?

The Assassin emblem: 37 heroes out of 133. The Mage and Fighter emblems come next.

Which battle spell is best in Mobile Legends?

Flicker most often: it is the main spell for 60 heroes out of 133. Junglers take Retribution.
